subject: Re: Redwood POC plan & success criteria / final readout scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novacarehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC plan (next steps)

Hi Olivia - great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking through NovaCare's evaluation objectives. Per our call, I pulled together a concise POC plan and mutual action plan to keep timelines tight and ownership clear. Attached: Redwood_POC_plan_v1.pdf and MAP_NovaCare.xlsx.

Quick recap of agreed items from today:
- Primary goal: Verify 90th percentile API latency under 250ms for standard clinical prompts (avg length ~120 tokens) and validate clinical-note summarization quality (ROUGE-like eval + small qualitative set).
- Success criteria: 1) 90th p latency <= 250ms under 50 concurrent sessions; 2) Summary accuracy judged >= 85% by your clinical SME panel on 20 sample notes; 3) No PII leakage and SOC2 evidence provided.
- POC scope (2 weeks): dev/devops integration + run 1-week realistic load window + qualitative readout with clinical SMEs.
- Owners: Redwood infra + Marissa (engagement lead), Marcus (runtime support), NovaCare: Olivia (clinical lead), Tom (platform/IT), Procurement for contract steps.
- Timeline (proposed): Week 1 (integration + prep), Week 2 (load test + eval), Readout and exec decision in Week 3.

Ask: Please confirm the success criteria and the proposed timeline. If that works, can we lock the readout slot for the week of June 21-25? We'll prepare a one-page readout deck and a short demo.

Next immediate step: I'll share the MAP and POC plan now - if Procurement needs contract language we can route a redline through DocuSign as soon as scope is agreed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_POC_plan_v1.pdf (POC plan, success criteria, test harness), MAP_NovaCare.xlsx (mutual action plan)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novacarehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novacarehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@novacarehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed POC plan (next steps)

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap and the docs. High level this aligns with what our committee discussed. A few minor edits from our side: 
1) Success criteria: add a qualitative flag for clinical safety - if any of the 20 samples have a safety concern (hallucination of medication or diagnosis), we flag as a fail until remediated.
2) Timeline: we need an extra buffer day between integration and load window for our IT change freeze; can we target integration complete by June 18 and run load June 21-24?
3) Owners: I'll be clinical SME lead. Tom will own the network/proxy testing. Procurement (cc'd) will review for the standard SOW.

We can confirm the readout for the executive team on Thurs June 24 at 11:00am PT. Procurement - can you review the MAP and let us know if you need a commercial LOI/PO before the readout?

Olivia
Olivia Chen, Director Clinical Technology | NovaCare Health
olivia.chen@novacarehealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0122

- Rishi: coordinate the SOC2/data handling docs and provide the log retention/audit details to Tom for compliance review. Target complete: June 16.
- Marissa (me): coordinate readout material and the one-page success metric dashboard; finalize MAP and send to Procurement for redline by June 14.

Attach: Redwood_POC_plan_v1.pdf (same doc) - I'll update the MAP with the small edits Olivia requested (add clinical safety flag).

Let me know if any of these tasks conflict with your calendars. We need clean run on June 21-24 and readout Thurs June 24 11:00am PT.

-Marissa

- Marcus: runtime image ready and validated in our staging with synthetic tokens simulating 120-token clinical prompts. 90th p latency under 230ms in staging.
- Rishi: SOC2 summary and data handling one-pager attached.
- Marissa: updated MAP attached with clinical safety flag and finalized sample set for SME review.

Action items for you: 
- Tom: please confirm network/proxy test window the week of June 14 so we don't hit the change freeze on the 18th.
- Olivia: confirm availability of clinical SMEs for June 23 afternoon for qualitative review.
- Procurement: please confirm whether you need an LOI/PO ahead of the readout; if so we can provide a standard SOW to expedite.

Readout draft deck link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPOCplan (we'll share final slides by June 22).

If everyone confirms, we'll proceed to run load tests June 21-24 and present the readout Thurs June 24, 11:00am PT as discussed.

Thanks,
Marissa
